transcript: Speaker A: I am charging the Phone. Charging means giving power. My phone gets energy. This is a Phone. I am unlocking the phone. Unlocking means opening the phone. I am making a Call. A call means talking on the phone. I speak to someone. I am sending a Message. Sending means giving information. I send a text. I am watching Videos. Watching means looking at something. I watch on my phone. I am scrolling the Screen. Scrolling means moving the screen up or down. I use my finger.
